trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are done — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work through the roadmap in order: finish the story first, then the 100% completion checklist, then Strangers & Freaks and the one-off trophies. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 difficulty and about 200 hours; the long pole is A Long Road, not difficulty, and there are no online trophies and no difficulty settings.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles, via Planet GTA 6 — trophy list

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1, and it unlocks. Nothing to prepare and nothing to watch for — just play the story.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when Chapter 1 ends — PowerPyx places the pop just after the first main mission of Chapter 2, 'What's in the Bag?'. Keep playing the story.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. Completing Chapter 2 unlocks it; PowerPyx places the pop after the first main mission of Chapter 3, 'Welcome to Vice City'.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. Completing Chapter 3 unlocks it, after the opening missions of Chapter 4 ('Ocean Beach' and 'Another Life', per PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. Completing Chapter 4 unlocks it, after the final Chapter 4 mission 'Starting From Zero'.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish the final mission and it unlocks. There is only one playthrough needed and no mission replay, so keep manual saves at the start of each chapter (PowerPyx recommends 10 saves: start and end of every chapter) in case you want to revisit anything.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 2 main mission 'Breakfast Run'. Just play the story.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 3 main mission 'The Cartel Heist'.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission 'Child's Play'.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission 'Headliners'.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission 'VCIA Takedown'.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 5 main mission 'Operation Savage Glory'.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set and the reason the platinum takes around 200 hours. After the story, the 100% checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and progress you made during the story already counts. The bar is forgiving — PowerPyx calls it roughly 60% of true completion: most side quests are not needed, collectibles are only partly required, and you need 70 of the 80 challenges. The only things that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Nothing on the checklist is missable; it can all be finished in free-roam after the story. Time-savers: do optional missions as they appear (you need any 100 of them), scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app (200 of 277 base models) and study animals with the binoculars (100 of 255).

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts; the 100% checklist wants 300. Four kinds count: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings, and 25 base jumps. Mix them — the under-the-bridge flights are the quickest. Track progress by region in Progress > Activities > Stunts, and stunts stay marked on the map once done (Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots).

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. The tracker lives under Touchpad > Progress > Activities. You meet most of them through the story and the other trophies, so this usually pops on its own.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every one of the 42 shooting range challenges across 12 ranges. The gold medals are not brutally hard, and you only need the ranges — no other shooting requirement feeds this one. PowerPyx lists all 12 range locations and the 42 golds.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations (42 races in total). You do not need to win all 42 — one win per location is enough. PowerPyx lists all 14 locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races from the 40 unique race locations around Leonida. Each location only counts once, so keep moving to new ones instead of repeating a favourite. PowerPyx lists all 40 race spots.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission 'Feng Shui', when you meet Cal, he will text you about a fishing spot (purple icon on the map). Follow Cal's fishing questline and beat him in a fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one of the four arcade games — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home (use the controllers); Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You must reach the end of the game, not beat every challenge. Pick whichever you enjoy most.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia only. Andy's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 3; she calls, then texts her address in Belville. Finish her five quests — 'Climbing the Cellerichain' (parts 1–3), 'Pay the Cellerica Fee', 'Peach!', 'Read the Label' and 'Puff Puff Pass' — and the trophy pops on the last one. The quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's treasure-diving questline starts in Chapter 1 (after the mission 'Island Dreams'), marked by the green 'KR' icon in Key Lento. He marks shipwrecks on the map; dive down, dig the treasure up with the metal detector, and bring it back. Clear all 7 shipwrecks across his quest sets. Kenton goes quiet for a while after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2–3 — nothing here is missable. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline is marked after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break', at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. Finish his five jobs — 'Thrillbillies', 'Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab', 'Mall Rats', 'The Impaler' and 'Hometown Heroes'. All of them stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands. Only certain strangers count — Kirk (Skunk Ape / Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries) are confirmed; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this one. All of them remain available in free-roam after the story, and the trophy tracker shows your count.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's wish list. It is marked after the Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS', where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars; deliver each to his garage (green 'RK' icon in west Vice City) and he pays more for good condition. Cars he marks appear in fixed spots, but you can also steal them off the street — scan a car with the WAiNK app to see if it is on the list. Everything stays doable after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason only. Tyrone's questline is marked after the Chapter 3 mission 'Here, Kitty Kitty'. Destroy the Synthetic Labs (purple markers in Vice City, quest 'Take Out Kitty Litter'), then his second quest 'Spin On This' opens and finishes the line. Still available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts double. THE MISSABLE ONE: in Chapter 1, after the mission 'Down to Earth', talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she will meditate, walks to the balcony, and you can accept to learn how. That session may be required — PowerPyx's author had done it when the trophy popped, and it is not marked as a normal meditation spot. Do it in Chapter 1; after that it is gone. You cannot reach the final spot until both characters can play together (after 'Coffee Break'). Track spots under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List (missable discussion)

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Jason only. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is marked after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break' — he texts Jason (Lucia cannot get the message) and the first quest 'Veteran Hunted' starts in Lummox County. Bret marks hunting spots; hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. His first quest gives you the 'Killtelligence SM-69' hunting rifle. One clean shot keeps the animal pristine and pays more, but is not required. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed. Track the 15 Target Decks under Map > Activities — all 15 are needed for the 100% checklist anyway.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card set locations in total; PowerPyx lists them all. Cards are a collectible type — pick up sets as you explore and this comes together.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1 to scan). There are far more than 100 — landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags — so scan whatever you pass. It overlaps with the vehicle and animal scanning for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this pops on the way there. Challenges are tracked under Progress > Challenges. Most complete naturally while you work on other trophies — save the last ones for cleanup and pick the easiest remaining.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you. Available after 'Coffee Break' (Chapter 2), when you can call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle). Cause mayhem until you hit 4 stars, then escape on a fast sports bike — or drive the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and the helicopter struggle to follow. The trophy pops when you leave the red heat zone. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 bank vault robberies, which always trigger 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level. Keep the flashing red/blue wanted level (not the full red heat level) the whole time — bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City work well (after 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs' in Chapter 3); rob a couple of items in each and break the safe in the back room. The pop is delayed about half a minute after leaving the third shop — if it does not come, hit a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Leonida has 557 vehicles at launch; the fastest way is the WAiNK app — stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. Scanning is enough, you do not have to drive them. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this comes free. Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming). It slows time and highlights weak spots, but only lasts a few seconds, so buff your focus first — eat or drink, wash up at home, and use Adrenaline to stretch it. Line up 5 enemies (gang operations work well), wear body armor, and use an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. It does not seem to count against soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots; you will likely reach level 4 naturally.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA — it must be one connected to a boarding bridge, not the planes on the airfield. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the bridge, go upstairs into the cockpit, reverse the plane to the runway and take off. Fly at least 1 km from the airport and the trophy pops (slightly delayed).

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base — drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance. Get in a tank, shoot at some enemies, and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs' — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently picking alarmed doors and marks jewelry store robberies (green icons). Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun (do not kick it — that trips the alarm), find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot. The trophy pops shortly after you leave.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Start with the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' (wait at the cafe): tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner — you cannot carry all the cash alone, hand off a bag (hold Right). After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark security vans (after his earlier Payday Loans jobs). Each vault robbery triggers 4 stars, so escape on a fast bike and switch vehicles to shake the heat. There are 8 large bank jobs; the 100% checklist needs all 8, so this comes automatically.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically in the Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…', since robbing the bank vault counts as robbing the armored truck. Or do it early: find an armored truck near a bank in Vice City, block it, stick a bomb on its back door and blow it open — the trophy only pops once you have escaped the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his jobs.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the whole map is visible. PowerPyx has a dedicated unfogging route and plane recommendation.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total; you only need one per gang for this trophy, but the 100% checklist needs all 39. Operations show as yellow icons when you are near them and many are marked through the story. Track each gang's count under Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach and buy an Apple Martini. Drink it while standing next to the bar and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. You need the Key Cloner first, unlocked in the Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS'. Only this specific blue Banshee counts. The pop is slightly delayed, after you have driven away down the street.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (a gang operation): the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique 'Gutterball Moreland 850' shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation). The place is marked during the Chapter 2 optional mission 'Hit Kingpin Bowling'. The trophy pops after you escape the police — and you do not need all 3 in one visit; the robbery icon respawns, so you can come back for the rest.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Available after 'Coffee Break' (Chapter 2), when you can switch between characters. Buy a fitness club membership and always train together (hold Right, press Triangle to call your partner) — while one works out, the other finishes their training too, so you progress twice as fast. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia. You can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) and you will see a small demon face whenever an action counts. The five profile tiers run Professional (stealthy jobs, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing), Psycho (mass killing, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable (permanent — avoid it, cops get far more aggressive). It happens passively while you play; if you are short at the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed at launch. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be tied to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. Until players pin it down, visit the Payday Loans store early and see what it offers — this guide will be updated when the trigger is confirmed.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List (unconfirmed triggers)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. After 2AM, go alone to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back. Follow the path into the woods from the car and you will see the UFO (bright blue light in the sky). Approach it; it drops a woman it abducted. Talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside to unlock the trophy. The spawn is slightly random, not guaranteed.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed at launch. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to come from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle — a melee drive-by. Try it on enemies while riding; this guide will be updated when players confirm the exact trigger.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List (unconfirmed triggers)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission 'Credit Check' (meet Raul's crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans, and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total counts across all robberies, not in one trip. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, so this comes naturally while doing the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way there since they are the most expensive. Leonida has 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 67 clothing stores, 11 tattoo studios and more — spend anywhere and it counts.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (the 4 story-related garages do not count). They cost $160,000 in total and go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission 'Daily Driver', when the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone — buy them through the app. Robberies in Chapters 3–4 are the quickest way to fund them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles with the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission 'Moses'. You need enough garages first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose 'Respray' then 'Register' in his garage. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can register standard-tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
